historical_C49.C49_Deck_scope: On a Steam Deck that already had Battle.net and WoW set up, Candidate 49 found both. In a live test on that Deck, an older test copy of the installer found Candidate 49 on GitHub. After Update now was pressed, it downloaded and installed the signed update, kept the previous copy as a backup, and restarted as Candidate 49. That updated window later closed unexpectedly before it could be closed normally. The cause is not known, but the update had finished: Candidate 49 and the backup were still in place. In a separate check, Candidate 49 stayed open on the Deck through checks every two minutes for 30 minutes, then closed normally. The update on/off switch also worked on the Deck: after it was turned off, it stayed off when the installer was reopened.
